name: Do Quyen Waterfall
summary: Walk from km 16 to Đỗ Quyên, a fall on a headwater of the Hương. The path is about 1.5 km and about 30 minutes, with nearly 700 steps if you go down. The height is higher than 300 m, about 300 m, and nearly 400 m. Red đỗ quyên flowers on the rocks in spring. This walk uses the park ticket. Be back at the visitor center before 17:00.
getThere: From km 16 on the summit road. Road minutes are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: White water down the cliff at Đỗ Quyên, with forest at the sides
gettingThere: The trail leaves km 16 of the Bạch Mã road. One length is about 1.5 km and about 30 minutes to the lip. Another length is about 2 km of path after about 3 km of road down from the viewpoint. A combined walk with the five pools is about 3.3 km, with a 500 m spur to the fall. Nearly 700 steps go down the cliff. The road minutes from the gate are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From km 16
legs.body: Walk the trail from the road. About 1.5 km and about 30 minutes to the lip, then nearly 700 steps if you go down. Be back at the visitor center before 17:00.

legs.heading: From the viewpoint
legs.body: About 3 km by road down from the viewpoint, then about 2 km of path. The path from km 16 is about 1.5 km. Keep both lengths.

hours: Report at the visitor center before 09:00 on a day from the gate. Be back before 17:00 the same day. Another clock is 07:30–17:00.
closed: Check on arrival for a weekly closing day.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. This walk uses the park ticket. Adult prices are 65,000 đồng and 60,000 đồng. The reduced ticket is 25,000 đồng and also 20,000 đồng.
